title: The base-change exchange square for global Hom comparisons
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ and $g:Y'\to Y$ be morphisms of schemes, and let $X'=X\times_Y Y'$ with projections $g_X:X'\to X$ and $f':X'\to Y'$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. On the derived categories of structure-sheaf modules [def-pc-derived-category], write $F=Rf_*$, $F'=Rf'_*$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image], $L=Lg^*$ and $L_X=Lg_X^*$ [def-pc-derived-pullback], with canonical base-change map $\beta:LF\to F' L_X$ [def-pc-derived-base-change-map]. Write $H_Z(P,Q)=R\operatorname{Hom}_Z(P,Q)$ [def-pc-global-derived-rhom], $S_h$ for restriction of global scalars, $p_h$ for the canonical global Hom pullback comparison, $s:S_fS_{g_X}\cong S_gS_{f'}$ for the scalar-square comparison [def-pc-global-hom-pullback-comparison], and $d_h$ for the evaluation-mate direct-image global Hom comparison [lem-pc-global-hom-adjunction]. For arbitrary $M,N\in D(\mathcal O_X)$, the two morphisms from $S_fH_X(M,N)$ to $S_gH_{Y'}(LFM,F' L_XN)$ satisfy $$S_f(p_{g_X}(M,N));s_{H_{X'}(L_XM,L_XN)};S_g(d_{f'}(L_XM,L_XN));S_gH_{Y'}(\beta_M,1)=d_f(M,N);p_g(FM,FN);S_gH_{Y'}(1,\beta_N).$$ In particular, no invertibility of either base-change component is assumed.

proof.text: Use lem-sc-internal-hom-base-change-exchange for the internal-Hom objects E=H_X(M,N) and E'=H_X'(LgX^*M,LgX^*N). It identifies beta_E;Rf'_*(p_gX);c_f';H(beta_M,1) with Lg^*(c_f);p_g;H(1,beta_N).
Apply lem-sc-global-sections-base-change-mate to E,E' and a=p_gX. It transports the first three Leray/scalar factors of the left global path to the g-adjunction transpose of beta_E;Rf'_*(a).

Postcompose the transported equation with the image under S_g RΓ(Y',-) of b=c_f';H(beta_M,1). The fully proved private globalMate_postcomp lemma moves b inside the g-adjunction transpose using Leray naturality and adjunction naturality on the right. Substitute the internal exchange equation. Adjunction naturality on the left moves c_f out of the transpose, and the same private lemma moves H(1,beta_N) back outside. These operations form the fully proved private globalMate_exchange lemma. Expanding the global comparison definitions, functor map_comp, product/opposite functor objects, and categorical associativity gives exactly the unchanged target equation.

theorem schemeGlobalHom_baseChange_exchange
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ (R : Type u) [Ring R], HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleCat.{u} R)]
    {X Y Y' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y' ⟶ Y)
    (M N : schemeDerivedCategory X) :
    (schemeGlobalScalarRestriction f).map
        (schemeGlobalDerivedHom_pullback_comparison (pullback.fst f g) M N) ≫
      (schemeGlobalScalarSquareIso f (pullback.snd f g) g (pullback.fst f g)
        pullback.condition).hom.app
          ((schemeGlobalDerivedHom (pullback f g)).obj
            (op ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj M),
              (derivedPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj N)) ≫
      (schemeGlobalScalarRestriction g).map
        (schemeGlobalHomDirectImageMap (pullback.snd f g)
          ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj M)
          ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj N)) ≫
      (schemeGlobalScalarRestriction g).map
        ((schemeGlobalDerivedHom Y').map
          (X := (op ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f g)).obj
            ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj M)),
            (schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f g)).obj
              ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj N)))
          (Y := (op ((derivedPullback g).obj ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj M)),
            (schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f g)).obj
              ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj N)))
          ((schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f (pullback.snd f g) g
            (pullback.fst f g) pullback.condition M).op, 𝟙 _)) =
    schemeGlobalHomDirectImageMap f M N ≫
      schemeGlobalDerivedHom_pullback_comparison g
        ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj M) ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj N) ≫
      (schemeGlobalScalarRestriction g).map
        ((schemeGlobalDerivedHom Y').map
          ((𝟙 _).op, schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f (pullback.snd f g) g
            (pullback.fst f g) pullback.condition N))
